name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with static content, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, enables their services, creates Redis logging support, and applies Redis authentication and configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, application dependencies and environment settings, and a Uvicorn systemd service.
